name: Cover Story
concept: An editorial magazine cover for natural beauty: big serif headline, issue-style index of treatments, cream paper and an oxblood accent.
signature: headline set across the full width in two lines, second line in grey, with a 'contents' list of treatment categories opposite
founder story laid out as a magazine feature with a pull quote of the signature line
FAQ as a numbered 'reader questions' column
imagery: calm editorial portraits of skin and hands, cream backdrops, natural daylight; Bita's portrait as a clearly marked placeholder
why: Feels like a beauty editor recommended her: credible, calm and quietly luxurious.
